New York Shooting Injures Eight, Including Four Children

On the US Independence Day, a shooting incident occurred in New York, resulting in injuries to eight people, including four children. The injured children were reported to be aged 6, 7, 12, and 14. The event took place during the US Independence Day celebrations.
